shortDescription: So many ways to cook: Air Fry, Slow Cook, Steam Bake and more. No cooktop cleans easier than Induction. Skip preheating and start baking immediately with No Preheat.

features.text: Total Convection System
Gives you maximum versatility in the kitchen, powering cooking modes like Air Fry, No Preheat, Slow Cook, Convection Bake, Steam Bake, Convection Roast, Steam Roast and more!
Easy-to-Clean Cooktop
Unlike traditional electric and gas cooktops, Induction only heats the pan and the food in it, so the area around the pan stays cooler, allowing you to clean up spills and splatters while you cook.
No Preheat
Eliminates time wasted waiting on your oven to heat up - simply place your food in the cold oven and get to meal time, in no time.1
Air Fry
Make healthier and delicious meals for your entire family - right in your oven.
ReadyCook™ Air Fry Tray is included
For perfectly crispy and delicious Air Fry results.2
Slow Cook
With Slow Cook, your food cooks slowly and at a lower temperature (as low as 100° F), allowing you to lock in moisture and flavor without over or undercooking your food.
Faster Boil Times
With induction, heat transfers directly to the cookware bypassing the cooktop surface, making induction incredibly fast.
Temperature Probe
Monitors and alerts when the desired finished cooking temperature has been reached.
Steam Bake
With Steam Bake, steam evenly circulates throughout the oven cavity, resulting in breads and muffins that rise higher and are light and fluffy.
Consistent temperature with TempLock™
Sensors in the cooktop automatically adjust the power level to maintain a consistent temperature the entire time you cook - it's like cruise control for your cooktop
Convenient Bridge Element
Connects two elements to allow for simultaneous control, perfect for a griddle pan.
Two cleaning options
Select Steam Clean for a quick, 30 minute clean or choose Self Clean, which is available in 2, 3 and 4 hour cycles.
Backlit LED Knobs
Lights up when the cooktop is turned on.
Premium Glide Rack
Our extending Glide Rack makes it easier to monitor and lift your food out of the oven.
Safer Cooktop Surface
Induction only heats the pan and the food in it, so the area around the pan stays cooler.
Extra Wide Store-More™ Storage Drawer
Redesigned to be even wider - allowing you to store any unused oven racks, baking trays and more!
Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel
Resists fingerprints and cleans easily.
Frigidaire® Fit Promise

We promise that your new 30" Frigidaire front control range will fit your existing range cutout of the same width and configuration, or we will reimburse you up to one hundred dollars for professionally modifying the countertop.3
